title: Dicee Challenge Step 2 - Add Dice Images
section: 17. Boss Level Challenge 1 - The Dicee Game
summary: Step 2: point both img elements at the dice6.png file from the images folder.

concepts.heading: Setting image sources
points: The project has an images folder with dice1.png to dice6.png.
Each player's img element needs a src value of the relative path to dice6.png.
The reference markup gives each img its own class (img1 and img2) so JavaScript can select them separately, and an alt attribute for accessibility.
(Extra) Relative paths start from the HTML file's location, so ./images/dice6.png is correct when images sits next to index.html.

task.name: Step 2: dice images
task.goal: Both dice show the six face.
steps: Set src on the first img to the dice6.png path.
Do the same for the second img.
Open the page and confirm two six-faced dice.
task.expected_result: Two dice images appear, one per player.
